source_snapshot.items: Test connections between HMC I2C-9, HMC CPLD and HMC temperature sensor
source_snapshot.procedure: On HMC run broad `i2cdetect -y -q 8`, then `i2ctransfer -y 8 w2@0x39 0x00 0x00 r5`; PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: Collect results/photos and check logs; no five-byte/temperature oracle.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; substitutes probing/soldering for the HMC query.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Notes raw thermal-register risk but leaves CPLD/sensor attribution and r5 interpretation unresolved.

old_problem: No proof maps HMC I2C-9 to bus8 or identifies0x39 as CPLD, sensor or proxy; register0x0000 fields, temperature conversion/tolerance, scan safety, ownership and recovery are undefined.
disposition_reason: The named path can be functionally checked without physical probing, but an ACK/five raw bytes cannot prove both CPLD and temperature-sensor coverage. ED-03/15 require the OEM topology and byte-level thermal oracle; broad quick-write discovery is removed unless every address is approved safe.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row134, same-row AI fields and history2523; unique identity was confirmed.
Preserved bus8,0x39,0x0000,r5 and all three named HMC/CPLD/sensor elements.
Required device-versus-proxy attribution and independent timestamped temperature correlation.
Protected thermal control: no blind scan, register guess, fan override, heat stimulus, retry or DUT action.

test_case.purpose: Verify HMC obtains a valid temperature-sensor result through the intended CPLD/sensor path without modifying thermal control.
required_package: PID1114953 bus8 topology and0x39 CPLD/sensor/proxy identity
Register0x0000 five-byte layout, endian, status, signedness and temperature scaling
Expected valid ranges and correlation tolerance to an independent sensor/API
Bus8 owner and non-mutating pointer-read approval
test_case.test_command: Do not run broad `i2cdetect -q`. After topology/protocol approval, capture ownership, component identity and independent thermal baseline; execute one `i2ctransfer -y 8 w2@0x39 0x00 0x00 r5`; decode all fields, correlate temperature by timestamp, check errors/monitoring health and do not retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The approved request returns exactly five bytes with valid identity/status and a decoded temperature within the signed range/tolerance of independent telemetry; bus and thermal monitoring remain error-free and available.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires proven path/proxy identity, valid field bits, decoded temperature correlation and clean health. ACK/raw bytes alone, invalid status, implausible or out-of-tolerance temperature, NACK/timeout/stuck bus or monitoring degradation fails.
safety_gate: Confirm0x0000 is non-mutating and cannot alter fan/thermal policy.
Coordinate bus8 ownership; no forced or concurrent access.
No broad quick-write scan unless each address is vendor-approved safe.
One bounded read; stop on error/thermal-monitoring loss without retry, reset or fan change.
expected_evidence: HMC/CPLD/sensor identities, firmware, bus owner and thermal baseline
Vendor five-byte decoder and signed temperature oracle
Timestamped request, raw bytes, status/latency and decoded matrix
Independent temperature correlation, pre/post bus/thermal logs, monitoring health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The approved read should be state-neutral. Preserve logs and stop on failure; if monitoring degrades, use only the pre-approved management recovery while maintaining independent thermal protection.

source_conflict.reason: One unidentified response is claimed to cover CPLD and sensor without topology, field or thermal oracle; prior reviews add unsourced probing.

blocked.reason: The functional read and thermal purpose are clear; vendor topology/decoder and access controls are resolvable RPUC inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bus8/0x39 topology, proxy ownership, five-byte register/temperature decoder, safe access, correlation tolerance and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve the path, thermal byte oracle, scan/access policy, abort limits and recovery, then issue a revised record.

project_authority: PID1114953 and the HMC CPLD/sensor vendor register specification govern the OEM topology and thermal encoding.
